:::{#exm-vcov-psd}
#### Two variance matrices that differ only in sign

Let $\vX = \tp{(X_1, X_2)}$ be equally likely to be each of the four points

$$D_1 = \set{(-5, 1),\ (0, -1),\ (0, 1),\ (5, -1)},$$

and let $\vX'$ be equally likely to be each of the four points

$$D_2 = \set{(5, 1),\ (0, -1),\ (0, 1),\ (-5, -1)}.$$

Both sets have first coordinates $\set{-5, 0, 0, 5}$
and second coordinates $\set{1, -1, 1, -1}$,
so

$$
\begin{aligned}
\E{X_1} &= \E{X_2} \\
&= 0,
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
\E{X_1^2} &= (25 + 0 + 0 + 25)/4 \\
&= 12.5,
\end{aligned}
$$

and

$$
\begin{aligned}
\E{X_2^2} &= (1 + 1 + 1 + 1)/4 \\
&= 1,
\end{aligned}
$$

and likewise for $\vX'$.
They differ in the products of the coordinates:

$$
\ba
\E{X_1 X_2} &= \frac{(-5)(1) + (0)(-1) + (0)(1) + (5)(-1)}{4} \\
&= -2.5, \\
\E{X_1' X_2'} &= \frac{(5)(1) + (0)(-1) + (0)(1) + (-5)(-1)}{4} \\
&= 2.5.
\ea
$$

Since the [means](expectation.qmd#def-expectation) are 0, @def-cov-vec-x and @thm-alt-cov give:

$$
\Varf{\vX} = \pmat{12.5 & -2.5 \\ -2.5 & 1},
\qquad
\Varf{\vX'} = \pmat{12.5 & 2.5 \\ 2.5 & 1}.
$$

Both are symmetric.
@thm-var-lincom with $\va = \tp{(1, 1)}$ and $\va = \tp{(1, -1)}$ gives:

$$
\ba
\Var{X_1 + X_2} &= 12.5 + 1 + 2(-2.5) &
\Var{X_1 - X_2} &= 12.5 + 1 - 2(-2.5) \\
&= 8.5, &
&= 18.5, \\
\Var{X_1' + X_2'} &= 12.5 + 1 + 2(2.5) &
\Var{X_1' - X_2'} &= 12.5 + 1 - 2(2.5) \\
&= 18.5, &
&= 8.5.
\ea
$$

As a check, $X_1 + X_2$ takes the values $-4, -1, 1, 4$,
each with [probability](probability-basics.qmd#def-probability) $1/4$,
so its [mean](expectation.qmd#def-expectation) is 0 and its [variance](#def-variance) is $(16 + 1 + 1 + 16)/4 = 8.5$.

```{r}
#| label: fig-vcov-psd-points
#| fig-cap: >-
#|   The four equally likely points of X (set D1, left)
#|   and of X' (set D2, right).
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Two scatter plots of four points each, with X1 from -5 to 5
#|   on the horizontal axis and X2 from -1 to 1 on the vertical axis.
#|   In the left panel the outer points (-5, 1) and (5, -1)
#|   slope down from left to right;
#|   in the right panel the outer points (-5, -1) and (5, 1)
#|   slope up from left to right.
#|   The two middle points (0, -1) and (0, 1) are the same in both panels.
#| fig-height: 2.5
#| fig-width: 6
x1_d1 <- c(-5, 0, 0, 5)
x1_d2 <- c(5, 0, 0, -5)
x2_both <- c(1, -1, 1, -1)
d1 <- tibble::tibble(x1 = x1_d1, x2 = x2_both, set = "D1")
d2 <- tibble::tibble(x1 = x1_d2, x2 = x2_both, set = "D2")
points <- dplyr::bind_rows(d1, d2)
points |>
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::aes(x = x1, y = x2) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(size = 3) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(ggplot2::vars(set)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "X1", y = "X2")
```

:::
